snippet.title: Wander Scoop  | Date Announcement Trailer | Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
Don't you miss hot, sunny days 🌞, meeting strangers on the beach 🏖, and eating ice cream every day 🍦? Don't worry!
In Wander Scoop, you play as the ice-cream parlor owner, who adds a sprinkle of advice for your clients' struggles. Select flavors, choose toppings, and decorate your parlor, then learn more about the regular customers who purchase your treats.

Coming to Nintendo Switch on January 1! 🍨

Don't forget to follow us on 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/RedDeer_Games
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/RedDeerGames
and Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/reddeer_games/
